children: BiFu has launched Finloop USD Instant Digital Liquidity (FUIDL) for eligible institutions and professional investors, adding a tokenized U.S. dollar liquidity product to its RWA lineup. According to Foresight News, the product is supported by tokenized agency services from Finloop and connects to an international AAA-rated U.S. dollar money market fund.

The product uses a multi-chain issuance structure, with subscription and redemption processed on an hourly basis and interest accruing from the day funds arrive. BiFu's existing products cover crypto assets, foreign exchange, commodities, U.S. stocks, and RWA, and it plans to continue exploring secondary market mechanisms and liquidity development with Finloop.

title: BiFu Launches Tokenized Dollar Liquidity Product for Qualified Investors
